title: LeakSanitizer: detected memory leaks
body_html:
Compiling with GCC-11 (-fsanitize=address) is returning the following error:

=================================================================
==31634==ERROR: LeakSanitizer: detected memory leaks

Direct leak of 10707 byte(s) in 347 object(s) allocated from:
    #0 0xffff7f87432c in __interceptor_malloc ../../../../gcc-11.2.0/libsanitizer/asan/asan_malloc_linux.cpp:145
    #1 0x417208 in dup_line (/opt/ncl/ni/src/nyacc/nyacc+0x417208)
    #2 0x41bca4 in copy_action (/opt/ncl/ni/src/nyacc/nyacc+0x41bca4)
    #3 0x41d108 in read_grammar (/opt/ncl/ni/src/nyacc/nyacc+0x41d108)
    #4 0x41f864 in reader (/opt/ncl/ni/src/nyacc/nyacc+0x41f864)
    #5 0x405ca8 in main (/opt/ncl/ni/src/nyacc/nyacc+0x405ca8)
    #6 0xffff7f670de0 in __libc_start_main (/lib64/libc.so.6+0x20de0)
    #7 0x401468  (/opt/ncl/ni/src/nyacc/nyacc+0x401468)

...
2 more descriptions of memory leaks 
...

SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: 12048 byte(s) leaked in 367 allocation(s).

I have gone over the different components but I just cannot pinpoint which is causing the memory leak. Any suggestion on what to try would be welcomed. The modified copy_action reads:

void
copy_action()
{
    register int c;
    register int i, n;
    int depth;
    int quote;
    char *tag;
    register FILE *f = action_file;
    int a_lineno = lineno;
    char *a_line = dup_line();
    char *a_cptr = a_line + (cptr - line);

    if (last_was_action)
        insert_empty_rule();
    last_was_action = 1;

    fprintf(f, "case %d:\n", nrules - 2);
    if (!lflag)
        fprintf(f, line_format, lineno, input_file_name);
    if (*cptr == '=') ++cptr;

    n = 0;
    for (i = nitems - 1; pitem[i]; --i) ++n;

    depth = 0;
loop:
    c = *cptr;
    if (c == '$')
    {
        if (cptr[1] == '<')
        {
            int d_lineno = lineno;
            char *d_line = dup_line();
            char *d_cptr = d_line + (cptr - line);

            ++cptr;
            tag = get_tag();
            c = *cptr;
            if (c == '$')
            {
                fprintf(f, "yyval.%s", tag);
                ++cptr;
                FREE(d_line);
                goto loop;
            }
            else if (isdigit(c))
            {
                i = get_number();
                if (i > n) dollar_warning(d_lineno, i);
                fprintf(f, "yyvsp[%d].%s", i - n, tag);
                FREE(d_line);
                goto loop;
            }
            else if (c == '-' && isdigit(cptr[1]))
            {
                ++cptr;
                i = -get_number() - n;
                fprintf(f, "yyvsp[%d].%s", i, tag);
                FREE(d_line);
                goto loop;
            }
            else
                dollar_error(d_lineno, d_line, d_cptr);
        }
        else if (cptr[1] == '$')
        {
            if (ntags)
            {
                tag = plhs[nrules]->tag;
                if (tag == 0) untyped_lhs();
                fprintf(f, "yyval.%s", tag);
            }
            else
                fprintf(f, "yyval");
            cptr += 2;
            goto loop;
        }
        else if (isdigit(cptr[1]))
        {
            ++cptr;
            i = get_number();
            if (ntags)
            {
                if (i <= 0 || i > n)
                    unknown_rhs(i);
                tag = pitem[nitems + i - n - 1]->tag;
                if (tag == 0) untyped_rhs(i, pitem[nitems + i - n - 1]->name);
                fprintf(f, "yyvsp[%d].%s", i - n, tag);
            }
            else
            {
                if (i > n)
                    dollar_warning(lineno, i);
                fprintf(f, "yyvsp[%d]", i - n);
            }
            goto loop;
        }
        else if (cptr[1] == '-')
        {
            cptr += 2;
            i = get_number();
            if (ntags)
                unknown_rhs(-i);
            fprintf(f, "yyvsp[%d]", -i - n);
            goto loop;
        }
    }
    if (isalpha(c) || c == '_' || c == '$')
    {
        do
        {
            putc(c, f);
            c = *++cptr;
        } while (isalnum(c) || c == '_' || c == '$');
        goto loop;
    }
    putc(c, f);
    ++cptr;
    switch (c)
    {
    case '\n':
    next_line:
        get_line();
        if (line) goto loop;
        unterminated_action(a_lineno, a_line, a_cptr);

    case ';':
        if (depth > 0) goto loop;
        fprintf(f, "\nbreak;\n");
        return;

    case '{':
        ++depth;
        goto loop;

    case '}':
        if (--depth > 0) goto loop;
        fprintf(f, "\nbreak;\n");
        return;

    case '\'':
    case '"':
        {
            int s_lineno = lineno;
            char *s_line = dup_line();
            char *s_cptr = s_line + (cptr - line - 1);

            quote = c;
            for (;;)
            {
                c = *cptr++;
                putc(c, f);
                if (c == quote)
                {
                    FREE(s_line);
                    goto loop;
                }
                if (c == '\n')
                    unterminated_string(s_lineno, s_line, s_cptr);
                if (c == '\\')
                {
                    c = *cptr++;
                    putc(c, f);
                    if (c == '\n')
                    {
                        get_line();
                        if (line == 0)
                            unterminated_string(s_lineno, s_line, s_cptr);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    case '/':
        c = *cptr;
        if (c == '/')
        {
            putc('*', f);
            while ((c = *++cptr) != '\n')
            {
                if (c == '*' && cptr[1] == '/')
                    fprintf(f, "* ");
                else
                    putc(c, f);
            }
            fprintf(f, "*/\n");
            goto next_line;
        }
        if (c == '*')
        {
            int c_lineno = lineno;
            char *c_line = dup_line();
            char *c_cptr = c_line + (cptr - line - 1);

            putc('*', f);
            ++cptr;
            for (;;)
            {
                c = *cptr++;
                putc(c, f);
                if (c == '*' && *cptr == '/')
                {
                    putc('/', f);
                    ++cptr;
                    FREE(c_line);
                    goto loop;
                }
                if (c == '\n')
                {
                    get_line();
                    if (line == 0)
                        unterminated_comment(c_lineno, c_line, c_cptr);
                }
            }
        }
        goto loop;

    default:
        goto loop;
    }
    FREE(a_line)
}

Here. I'm still missing something.

events.body_html: You have to share your code.
Build with debug symbols turned on and you'll get line numbers.
The code is huge and available at github.com/NCAR/ncl.
Stephen. I'm looking at gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gcc/Debugging-Options.html but I'm not sure which option you're suggesting. Do you mean including -g?
In copy_action, the char *a_line = dup_line(); doesn't seem to be matched by a FREE(a_line) anywhere? Nor is it returned or passed out of the function that I can see.
Hi Nate. Yes, that is what I was looking at. Are you looking at the file in the repository? I tried adding free(a_line) but didn't work, not sure if the capitals make any difference.

When I add FREE(a_line) at the end of the loop in copy_action it doesn't build 'nyacc' due to ../../.././ni/src/nyacc/nyacc -d -t ncl.y make[4]: ../../.././ni/src/nyacc/nyacc: Command not found make[4]: *** [Makefile:830: y.tab.h] Error 127 (I'm posting the modified code with the original post)

FREE is a function-like macro that just calls free, but you might as well use it for consistency. But like a function, it needs a semicolon at the end of the statement, which you have omitted. It's unclear if that is the cause of your error; if so there would have been more specific compilation errors further up, that maybe you left out.

Putting the FREE(a_line); at the end of the function won't fix the leak, though, because copy_action has return; statements at several other places. You need to make sure that a_line gets freed no matter which one of them is taken. In fact it looks to me like putting it at the end is completely unreachable; every branch of the preceding switch ends with either return or goto (ugh ugh ugh) but never break.
Either that or you decide that 10 KB of leaked memory isn't worth your time to sort through this antique spaghetti.

Hi Nate. Thanks. Unfortunately one customer needs it so I have no choice but to keep stitching it up until it works. As you mention, I need to go over every potential scenario and free the memory when needed.
